territorial_scope.description: Applies to United States persons, including those abroad and foreign branches, and to transactions involving covered foreign persons, including those determined by the Secretary.

evidence.quote: to block and prohibit all transactions in property and interests in property of a foreign person that is determined to be a covered foreign person pursuant to subsection (a)

agora_strategies: Tiering: Tiering based on domain of application

summary.short: As introduced, amends the Defense Production Act so the Treasury Secretary can prohibit, or require notification of, US-person investments in China involving listed technologies such as chips and AI. Also authorizes IEEPA sanctions on designated Chinese covered foreign persons; regulations due within 450 days of enactment.
summary.long: As introduced, the bill has three titles. Title I authorizes the President to block property of foreign persons that the Secretary, in consultation with the Secretary of State, determines to be covered foreign persons (entities incorporated in or controlled from China, Chinese Communist Party Central Committee members, and persons knowingly engaged in significant defense or surveillance operations), using IEEPA powers and penalties. Title II adds Title VIII to the Defense Production Act: the Secretary may prohibit US persons from knowingly engaging in covered national security transactions in prohibited technologies (including listed chip, AI, quantum and hypersonic items) and, within 450 days of enactment, must issue rules requiring notification within 30 days of completion for transactions in prohibited and notifiable technologies. Civil penalties are the greater of $250,000 or twice the transaction amount, and divestment may be compelled. Exemptions cover de minimis transactions, listed securities and certain fund interests. Title III requires reports within 365 days on the Non-SDN Chinese Military-Industrial Complex Companies List and directs rules barring US persons from knowingly holding listed securities after 365 days, subject to waiver. The Act ends when Commerce removes the PRC from 15 CFR 791.4. $150,000,000 is authorized for the first two fiscal years.

notes: Introduced bill text; effective timing runs from the date of enactment and is not otherwise dated. Internal inconsistencies: (1) covered foreign person is defined separately in Sec. 102(3) (Title I; requires knowingly significant operations in the defense or surveillance sectors) and Sec. 807(3) (inserted Title VIII; no such requirement; different clauses). Appropriate congressional committees and country of concern are also defined differently in Secs. 102, 301(d) and 807. (2) Sec. 102(5) refers to 'or any successor order' while Sec. 301(d)(3) refers to 'and any successor order'. (3) Secretary means the Treasury Secretary (Secs. 2, 807(9)), but the Sec. 5 termination turns on a Commerce Department rule. Title VIII provisions are cited as Secs. 801-807 of the inserted title. Relations cover only references stated in this text.

thresholds.variable_text: ownership share held in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, by listed entities
thresholds.consequence: A foreign person owned 50 percent or more by listed entities falls within the covered foreign person definition (Title I).
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the control and incorporation criteria in clauses (i) to (v); also requires knowing significant operations in the defense or surveillance sector under subparagraph (B).

evidence.quote: that is owned in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, 50 percent or more by an entity or a group of entities described in clause (i), (ii), (iii), or (iv)

thresholds.variable_text: ownership share held in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, by a country of concern or listed entities
thresholds.consequence: A foreign person owned 50 percent or more by listed entities falls within the covered foreign person definition (Title VIII).
thresholds.conditions: Subject to regulations prescribed under Title VIII; alternative to the other criteria in subparagraphs (A) to (C).

evidence.quote: is owned in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, 50 percent or more by a country of concern

thresholds.variable_text: ownership share held in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, by listed entities
thresholds.consequence: A foreign person owned 50 percent or more by listed entities is a PRC person for the purposes of the Non-SDN list reporting requirement.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the other criteria in subparagraphs (A) to (C).

evidence.quote: is owned in the aggregate, directly or indirectly, 50 percent or more by an entity or a group of entities described in subparagraph (A), (B), or (C)

thresholds.variable_text: limited partner or equivalent's committed capital in a pooled investment fund
thresholds.measurement: committed capital aggregated across any investment and co-investment vehicles of the fund
thresholds.consequence: A limited partner interest in a pooled fund at or below this committed capital is excluded from the covered national security transaction definition.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the binding contractual assurance in clause (bb) that the fund's capital will not be used for a covered transaction.

evidence.quote: the limited partner or equivalent’s committed capital is not more than $2,000,000, aggregated across any investment and co-investment vehicles of the fund

thresholds.variable_text: computing power used to train an artificial intelligence system
thresholds.measurement: quantity of computing power used in training
thresholds.consequence: An artificial intelligence system trained with computing power above this quantity is a notifiable technology.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the military end-use and intended-use criteria in subclauses (I) and (II). The source renders the exponent as '1023'; entered as 1e23. The Secretary may refine technical parameters under paragraph (B).

evidence.quote: trained using a quantity of computing power greater than 1023 computational operations

thresholds.variable_text: training compute of artificial intelligence models
thresholds.consequence: Development, design or production of artificial intelligence models trained at or above this compute is a prohibited technology.
thresholds.conditions: The source renders the exponent as '1025'; entered as 1e25. Prohibition applies through the covered national security transaction provisions of Title VIII.

evidence.quote: develops, designs, or produces any artificial intelligence models trained with at least 1025 floating point operations
